candidate.title: scTrio-seq
candidate.scope: Assigned Illumina scTrio-seq (single-cell triple omics sequencing) row only, read at schematic scope and interpreted against Hou et al. 2016 (PMID 26902283). The full attached crop also contains a neighboring G&T-seq row and part of the RNA Modifications/MeRIP row; those are outside this card’s target. The target row depicts cell isolation, lysis/centrifugation, an RNA-to-cDNA route, a direct DNA-adaptor route, and a methylated-DNA/bisulfite route ending in aligned reads. Every depicted route is retained. Primary scTrio-seq physically separates two fractions and obtains three biological measurements from transcript-derived and scRRBS data; the extra middle DNA route is explicitly qualified rather than promoted to a verified independent third library. scRRBS and the RNA-sequencing preparation are components, not additional method targets. This record does not assert later scTrio-seq versions or interchangeable alternative protocols.

method_scopes.rationale: The card title, row label, and verified collection heading identify one target. All listed operations belong to its displayed row, including three distinct local PCR and sequence instances and three branch-specific Align sequences instances under the shared final caption. Applicability is to this annotated schematic, not a claim that every scTrio-seq implementation has three independent libraries. Hou establishes the two-fraction scRNA-seq/scRRBS implementation and CNVs from scRRBS; the middle direct-DNA operations remain explicitly depicted-only. Neighboring G&T-seq and MeRIP workflows, Hu’s scMT-seq, and named component protocols do not expand the method list.
